scope: Spline Bayesian iterations BayesMinus1, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/bayes_iteration/BayesMinus1/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source, so the source stays in the budget. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
